The School of Interdisciplinary Studies advising team is committed to assisting you in the development of an educational plan that is compatible with your career goals. Academic advisors work with you to provide you with the resources you need to successfully complete your academic degree. Advising is an important part of a successful college experience. To ensure that you get the most out of your advising appointment, it is recommended that you take an active part in your degree planning. Interdisciplinary Studies advisors can assist you with: Degree plan requirements Course selection Changing your major/minor Transfer credit approval Applying for graduation Graduation audit Referrals to other UTD resources As a student, you are responsible for: Meeting with your advisor each semester Reviewing course offerings Sharing courses you want to take with your advisor Contacting your advisor with other questions about your degree Contact Us Advising Faculty Listing Staff Listing Gender Studies Faculty Organizational Chart School of Interdisciplinary Studies, HH 30. 800 W.
